text:
incbot: ALERT: Smart-routing errors > 5% for rollout policy 'r-2026-03' in eu-west-1. Error class: ModelVariantMismatch causing 502s and fallback churn. Impacting ~4.8% of requests. Pager: sara_oncall.

sara_oncall: acked, looking. seeing 502s + a bunch of retry loops in the logs. any recent policy changes?

jon_sre: I see a canary rollout started ~10m ago to variant v2-quant. Traffic split 10% canary, routing policy sticky=true. Looks like v2-quant fails for long seqs and triggers fallback to v1. Sticky fallback is reattaching users to failing variant, causing oscillation.

ana_ml: @jon_sre small correction: the canary is v2-int8 (not quant). It has different kv cache keys and occasionally times out on attention kernel selection. We saw similar in staging but not at this seq distribution.

luca_prod: customer impact: some prod tenants report slow responses and occasional endpoint 502s; CS ticket volume up. Beth, can you get rough count of customers affected?

beth_support: pulling incidents: looks like 37 unique tenant ids, ~4.8% of total requests last 15m, concentrated in eu-west-1 and a small batch in us-central1 due to routing failover. Raising support incident and template to affected accounts.

sara_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) pause the canary rollout 2) set smart-routing sticky fallback -> false 3) route new canary traffic to v1 stable 4) if needed, rollback canary. Who can pause rollout?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 'r-2026-03' status: RUNNING -> PAUSE_REQUESTED by sara_oncall.

jon_sre: I can pause it. pausing now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 'r-2026-03' status: PAUSED by jon_sre at 1901234702.

ana_ml: good. Also change rollback-sticky true -> false in policy to avoid reattachments. Config snippet (from policy store):

```
policy_id: r-2026-03
traffic_split:
  v1-stable: 90
  v2-int8: 10
sticky_fallback: true
fallback_policy:
  prefer_regional: true
```

Change to sticky_fallback: false and reapply.

jon_sre: applying change now to policy-store...

jon_sre: done. policy-store update confirmed at 1901234750. sticky_fallback=false.

sara_oncall: re-routing new sessions to v1-stable only until we confirm health metrics. Luca, can you coord with infra to scale v1 if CPU spikes?

luca_prod: infra scaling request sent to autoscaler team. They responded: +20% GPU pool in eu-west-1 warming. ETA 3m.

beth_support: Noted. Sending status update to affected tenants: we paused canary and routing stabilized. No data exposure.

ana_ml: quick diagnostic: attaching sample logs -> a few examples where v2-int8 produced invalid kvcache lookup and then stalled for 4-7s before fallback. That latency causes client retries which amplify the loop. We should add a fast-fail threshold on new variants.

jon_sre: agree. Add temporary circuit-breaker: if variant latency > 2s for 1% of requests over 1m, route away. Can implement via runtime flags. I'll push a hotfix rule.

jon_sre: pushed circuit-breaker rule at 1901234810. Active.

incbot: SYSTEM: Circuit-breaker rule added by jon_sre.

sara_oncall: monitoring. any sign of rollback or further 502s?

beth_support: error rate down to 0.6% in eu-west-1 within 2m of pausing & sticky=false. Customer tickets rate decreasing.

ana_ml: we will roll back v2-int8 to staging for repro and fix the kernel selection issue. ETA 2h for root-cause and patch.

luca_prod: outreach: posting incident update to status.redwood.ai. Notifying enterprise contacts for affected tenants.

sara_oncall: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. jon_sre will lead post-mitigation checks; ana_ml will own debugging and regression tests. Beth will follow up on customer comms. If error rate resurges, page the SRE rotation.

jon_sre: taking lead. setting this thread to incident-handled but will keep monitoring channel open for followups.

incbot: INCIDENT: Smart-routing policy oscillation -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to SEV3 at 1901234875.

beth_support: follow-up note: 37 tenants affected, no PII exposure, transient errors resolved. Will send postmortem template to owners.

ana_ml: adding to regression suite: long-sequence synthetic tests against int8 variant and KV cache alignment.

sara_oncall: thanks everyone. putting an action item: add canary health gating (latency + kvcache validation) before rollout. assigned to ana_ml and jon_sre.

jon_sre: noted. I will create the ticket and link the policy test harness.

incbot: Thread closed for now; reopen if metrics breach thresholds.
